key_derivation: The set is exactly the union of the three TESTS assignments in Makefile.am (:143, :145, :208) — automake runs nothing else for `make check`. Each driver's data file is read off its single command line (tests/jqtest:5, tests/mantest:6, tests/base64test:5, tests/uritest:5, tests/optionaltest:5, tests/onigtest:5, tests/manonigtest:5); tests/shtest and tests/utf8test contain no --run-tests and are hand-written. The skip conditions are the two automake conditionals wrapping the TESTS += lines, whose definitions are configure.ac:52 (WIN32) and configure.ac:292 (WITH_ONIGURUMA). Complete because TEST
